senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. צְלֵי II, a. טְלַע) [to bend, hang over,] to halt; trnsf. to sin.
units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 764:13">Yalk. Num. 764</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 35:15">Ps. XXXV, 15</cite> sq.) <he>כשאני צוֹלַעַת מעט וכ׳</he> as soon as I halt a little (am afflicted for my sins), they gather themselves against me; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 13:1">Pesik. R. s. 13</cite> <he>נכים עושים הדין בצוֹלְעִים</he> the paralyzed execute judgment on the halting (the wicked punish the frail); <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 13:1">ib.</cite> [read:] <he>שמא נכים וחגרים עושים את הדין במי שצוֹלֵעַ</he> are the paralyzed and the crippled to punish him who halts?

senses.gloss: . Ib. <he>כשאני מְצַלַּעַת וכ׳</he> when I halt (sin), they rejoice.
